title: Mediterranean Hash Skillet
description: A hearty skillet dish featuring a mediterranean-inspired hash with crispy onions and a tangy yogurt sauce.

ingredients.name: Hash
ingredients.notes: any type of hash browned in a pan

instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the hash to the skillet and cook for 4-5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the cooked onions to the skillet and stir to combine.
Sprinkle the oregano over the hash and stir.
In a small bowl, whisk together the yogurt and garlic.
Pour the yogurt mixture over the hash and stir until combined.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the hash is crispy and the yogurt sauce is heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with additional oregano if desired.
